Extranodal marginal zone lymphoma of the thyroid
legend: Cytokeratin highlights destructive infiltration of the thyroid follicular epithelium by lymphoma cells (lymphoepithelial lesions).

diagnosis: Extranodal marginal zone lymphoma of the thyroid
legend: Heterogeneous infiltrate with small lymphocytes intermixed with scattered cells showing plasmacytic differentiation and a few large cells.

diagnosis: Extranodal marginal zone lymphoma of the thyroid
legend: Tumour cells with pale cytoplasm, slightly irregular or indented nuclei, dispersed chromatin, and inconspicuous nucleoli, intermixed with monocyte-like cells with abundant pale cytoplasm.

diagnosis: Extranodal marginal zone lymphoma of the thyroid
legend: An increased number of large cells, immunoblasts, and centroblast-like cells. Solid or sheet-like infiltrates of large cells are diagnostic of a diffuse large B-cell lymphoma component.

diagnosis: Extranodal marginal zone lymphoma of the thyroid
legend: Lymphoepithelial lesions with squamous metaplasia of thyroid follicular cells.

diagnosis: Extranodal marginal zone lymphoma of the thyroid
legend: Expansile, ball-like collections of lymphoma cells within thyroid follicles (MALT balls) are distinctive lymphoepithelial lesions.

diagnosis: Extranodal marginal zone lymphoma of the thyroid
legend: Lymphoma cells plugging the thyroid follicle in a MALT-ball lymphoepithelial lesion (sequential section of the case shown in Fig. <<26383>>, immunostained with CD20).

There is near complete effacement of the normal thyroid follicular epithelium by a neoplastic lymphoid population, showing marginal zone-like cells, monocyte-like cells, small lymphocytes and scattered plasma cells. Malt-balls are noted as lymphoepithelial lesions.
